data.case_title: Hunting license application rejected due to expired insurance proof
data.title: Hunting license application rejected – insurance proof expired

sender.name: Kreis Musterdithmarschen – Fachdienst Waffen und Jagd

data.summary: The Kreis Musterdithmarschen hunting authority (Fachdienst Waffen und Jagd) refuses to issue Tjark Beispielholm's application for a three-year hunting license (Jagdschein) because his submitted proof of hunting liability insurance expired on 30 June 2026. The license will be issued without a new application once a current insurance confirmation is submitted, and an objection (Widerspruch) is possible within one month of notification.
data.explanation: This is an official decision (Bescheid) from the hunting authority refusing your hunting license for now, because the liability insurance proof you submitted is out of date. You do not need to file a new application: once you send a current confirmation of hunting liability insurance, the license will be issued directly. If you disagree with this decision, you may also file an objection (Widerspruch); the app will show you until when this is possible. If you do neither, the license stays withheld.

items.title: Submit updated hunting liability insurance proof
items.action: Send the authority a current confirmation of hunting liability insurance (Jagdhaftpflichtversicherung) to replace the expired one.
items.consequence: The hunting license (Jagdschein) will remain withheld until a valid insurance confirmation is provided.

date.text: Sobald Sie eine gültige Versicherungsbestätigung nachreichen, stelle ich den Jagdschein ohne neuen Antrag aus.

items.quote: Sobald Sie eine gültige Versicherungsbestätigung nachreichen, stelle ich den Jagdschein ohne neuen Antrag aus.

items.title: File objection (Widerspruch) against the rejection, if desired
items.action: If you disagree with the rejection, submit a written objection (Widerspruch) to the Kreis Musterdithmarschen by the deadline shown.
items.consequence: If no objection is filed in time, the rejection becomes final.
